title: N4019226R9100 - Integrated Solid Waste Management and Pavement Clearance Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC PACIFIC CMD.NAVFAC MARIANAS.NAVFACSYSCOM MARIANAS
detail_text: SOLICITATION NO. N40192-26-R-9100, Integrated Solid Waste Management and Pavement Clearance Services (ISWM) at all U.S. Military Facilities at U.S. Naval Base Guam Activities and tenants; Andersen Air Force Base Activities; Marine Corps Base Camp Blaz Activities; tenant commands, Industrial and U.S. Naval Hospital Facilities (Medical Treatment Facilities) in Guam; other U.S. Military Activities or DoD/Federal Agencies at various activities and locations in Guam; the Marianas Islands; the Commonwealth of the Northern Marianas Islands (CNMI); the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM); and the Republic of Palau.
